name: Ohio
uniformActsAdopted: Revised Uniform Fiduciary Access to Digital Assets Act

citations.title: Formality of execution
citations.quote: authorizes an attorney in fact ... to make health care decisions for the principal at any time that the attending physician of the principal determines that the principal has lost the capacity to make informed health care decisions

citations.title: Authority of attorney in fact under a durable power of attorney for health care
citations.quote: only if the attending physician of the principal determines that the principal has lost the capacity to make informed health care decisions for the principal

citations.title: Power of attorney is durable
citations.quote: A power of attorney created under sections 1337.21 to 1337.64 of the Revised Code is durable unless it expressly provides that it is terminated by the incapacity of the principal.

citations.title: Nomination of guardian; relation of agent to court-appointed fiduciary
citations.quote: In a power of attorney, a principal may nominate a guardian of the principal's person, estate, or both

citations.title: Termination of power of attorney or agent's authority
citations.quote: A power of attorney terminates when any of the following occurs: (1) The principal dies; (2) The principal becomes incapacitated, if the power of attorney is not durable

citations.title: Manner of making anatomical gift
citations.quote: A donor may make an anatomical gift by ... Authorizing a statement or symbol to be imprinted on the donor's driver's license or identification card

citations.title: Assignment of rights regarding disposition of remains
citations.quote: "Representative" means an adult or a group of adults, collectively, to whom a declarant has assigned the right of disposition.

citations.title: Written declaration of assignment
citations.quote: a statement that the declarant, an adult being of sound mind, willfully and voluntarily appoints a representative to have the declarant's right of disposition for the declarant's body upon the declarant's death

citations.title: Appointment of guardian - limited, interim, emergency, or standby guardian - nomination
citations.quote: a probate court on its own motion or on application by any interested party shall appoint ... a guardian of the person, the estate, or both, of a minor or incompetent

citations.title: Court may order estate released from administration
citations.quote: an estate may be released from administration ... if ... (1) The value of the assets of the estate is thirty-five thousand dollars or less.

citations.title: Letters testamentary shall issue
citations.quote: When a will is approved and allowed, the probate court shall issue letters testamentary to the executor named in the will

citations.title: Applicability
citations.quote: This chapter applies to ... An agent acting under a power of attorney ... A personal representative acting for a decedent ... A guardianship proceeding ... A trustee

citations.title: User direction for disclosure of digital assets
citations.quote: a direction regarding disclosure using an online tool overrides a contrary direction by the user in a will, trust, power of attorney, or other record

citations.title: Terms-of-service agreement
citations.quote: This chapter does not give a fiduciary or designated recipient any new or expanded rights other than those held by the user

assigned.event: Principal signs a power of attorney under the Ohio Uniform Power of Attorney Act

ends.event: Principal dies; revokes; the instrument's own terms; purpose accomplished; or no agent remains

patches.diff: Durability is the default in Ohio and has to be opted out of: a power of attorney is durable unless it expressly says it terminates on the principal's incapacity.

localNames: power of attorney expressly terminated by incapacity

ends.event: Principal becomes incapacitated, where the instrument expressly says it terminates on incapacity

patches.diff: A non-durable power exists in Ohio only where the principal opted out of durability in the instrument.

localNames: attorney in fact under a durable power of attorney for health care

assigned.event: Adult of sound mind executes a durable power of attorney for health care

starts.event: When the principal's attending physician determines the principal has lost the capacity to make informed health care decisions

patches.diff: Authority turns on a determination by the principal's own attending physician, not on a general finding of incapacity.

assigned.event: Probate court appoints, on its own motion or on application by an interested party, if found necessary

patches.diff: Appointment is by the probate court and may be made on the court's own motion, not only on application.

assigned.event: Probate court appoints a guardian of the estate

patches.diff: Ohio calls the property fiduciary a guardian of the estate rather than a conservator; the same section covers person, estate, or both.

starts.event: Probate court issues letters testamentary once the will is approved and allowed

patches.diff: Letters testamentary issue only after the will is approved and allowed, and only if the named executor is suitable, competent, accepts, and gives bond where required.

starts.event: Probate court orders the estate released from administration

patches.diff: Ohio releases an estate from administration rather than using an affidavit: assets of $35,000 or less, or $100,000 or less where the surviving spouse is the sole devisee.

assigned.event: User directs disclosure through the custodian's online tool

patches.diff: Ohio enacted the Revised Uniform Fiduciary Access to Digital Assets Act as Revised Code Chapter 2137; an online-tool direction overrides a contrary direction in a will, trust or power of attorney.

starts.event: Fiduciary acts for a user who resides or resided in Ohio

patches.diff: The chapter gives a fiduciary no rights beyond those the user held, and access can be modified or eliminated by the user, by federal law, or by the terms-of-service agreement where the user gave no direction.

assigned.event: Donor makes the gift by driver's licence or identification card symbol, vehicle registration, or (from 1 August 2025) a hunting or fishing licence application

patches.diff: Ohio adds a hunting or fishing licence application as a way of making an anatomical gift, effective 1 August 2025.

patches.name: Representative assigned the right of disposition
patches.summary: An adult may assign the right to control disposition of their own body to a named representative, or a group acting collectively, by a written declaration.

assigned.event: Declarant executes a written declaration appointing a representative

transitions.event: Written declaration assigning the right of disposition (§2108.70, §2108.72)
Death of the declarant; the representative's decisions are binding

patches.diff: Ohio lets an adult assign the right of disposition of their own remains to a named representative by written declaration, and makes that representative's decisions binding. The uniform/model baseline has no equivalent role.
